title: 해군함대령 / queue:ADDENDUM:29321:20181204:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Decree on Operations Commands) <Presidential Decree No. 29321, Dec. 4, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on January 1, 2019.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (14) Omitted.

(15) The Decree on Naval Fleets is partially amended as follows:

The title of Article 5, "(Maintenance of Military Customs and Discipline)," is replaced with "(Maintenance of Military Discipline)", and "military customs and discipline" in the main clause of that Article (excluding its title) is replaced with "military discipline (軍紀)".

(16) Omitted.

Article 4 Omitted.
